buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff.

4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of FA AND CAO, EAST COAST RAILWAY, BHUBANESWAR payable at SAMBALPUR . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT 1. The agency should provide semi-skilled cooked for cooking meals for each ti me breakfast, lunch & dinner at RPF Mess TIG, KBJ & BLGR for a perio d of 02 year i.e 730 days. 2. The agency should provide cooks on daily basis excluding rest giver and no mess will be kept vacant. 3. No residential accommodation will be provided by railway administration for any of the employee of the agency/firm/tenderer. The agency will provide ac commodation in a centralize manner to the Cooks deployed at RPF Post TI G, KBJ & BLGR. 4. The agency/firm/tenderer shall be solely responsible for all acts of commissi on/ omission of its employees. 5. The agency shall provide Cooks for the prescribed period. No extra paymen t shall be made for working on Sundays and National/General Holidays. 6. In case of any complain/defect pointed out by the authorities, the Contracto r shall immediately replace the cook. 7. LEAVE: - The Contractor shall deploy his employees in such a way that the y get weekly rest and other holidays, if admissible under various laws, which may be applicable in this regard. Leave Reserve in the ratio of 1:6 for weekly rest and other holidays will be provided excluding from the sanctioned stren gth. 8. It is obligatory on Contractor to comply with all provisions/ rules/ regulations under various acts and applicable as per Central Govt. Minimum Wages Act. 9. The Contractor shall not appoint any Sub-Company/Agency to carry out any obligation under the contract. 10. The Contractor shall provide the details of the staff, proposed to be deployed viz., their name, father’s name, DOB, residential address, Telephon e number, recent passport size photograph in the form of a data base in bot h hard & soft form and also provide a local police clearance certificate. Polic e verification is mandatory in respect of all staff employed. The same shall b e submitted to PC/ TIG, KBJ & BLGR. 11. If, the service provider is found unsatisfactory in any manner, the Rly have f ull power to discontinue the services by giving 7 days prior notice to the cont ractor. The decision of the Railway Administration in this regard shall be final . 12.The workers shall not be entitled for any financial benefits/emoluments that are admissible to regular employees of Railways. However, the service provi der is required to pay wages to the workers engaged strictly as per the rate

accepted by the administration. 13. The service provider will ensure to make payment of wages to the workers by 7th of every month. 14. The payment of wages to the workers have to be made by the tenderer in a ccordance with the provision of Section 21 of the service provider labour (Re gulation & Abolition) Act, 1970. The provisions of the said section are given a s under: “(Section:21) Responsibility for the payment of wages : (a) A service provider shall be responsible for payment of wages to each worker emplo yed by him as contract labour and such wages shall be paid before the expiry of suc h period as may be prescribed. (b) Every principal employer shall nominate a representative duly authorized by him to be present at the time of disbursement of wages by the service provider and it shall be duty of such representative to certify the amounts paid as wages in such manner as may be prescribed. (c) It shall be the duty of the service provider to ensure the disbursement of wages in t he presence of the authorized representative of the principal employer. (d) In case the service provider fails to make payment of wages within the prescribed p eriod or makes short payment, then the principal employer shall be liable to make p ayment of wages in full or the unpaid balance due, as the case may be, to the contra ct labour employed by the service provider and recover the amount so paid from the service provider either by deduction from any amount payable to the service provide r under any contract of as a debt payable by the service provider”. 15. Railway authority may exercise power to increase/decrease the requirement of Coo ks by giving prior notice to the contractor. 1 6 . The meals have to be cooked three times a day breakfast, lunch & dinner for RPF Mess TIG, KBJ & BLGR. In case of increase of staff, the cook should also be able to cook extra meals for the increased strength withou t any extra wages / remuneration. 17. The meal should be ready for the occupants in the Dining Hall o f the Barracks between 7.00 hrs to 8.00 hrs for breakfast, betwee n 12.00 hrs to 13.30 hrs for the lunch and between 19.00 to 20.30 hrs for dinner and also in emergency at odd hours if any. 18. The Mess Manager of RPF will work out the no. of meals required to be p repared for breakfast, lunch and dinner and the quantity of raw materials like Rice, Dal, Atta, Chicken, Meat, Vegetables, Curd etc required for the day and hand over other raw materials at least two - three hours before t he preparation of breakfast, lunch and dinner. 19. The cooks should take necessary steps for cleaning of messes, utensils, kitchen etc positively and take into account proper hygiene, cleanliness & taste of the cooked meals. 20. The LP gas, Gas stove, Refrigerator, cooking utensils and Mixers etc are alrea dy available in the mess for utilization during preparation of meals. 21. The cook must maintain neat & tidy to himself. He should produce med ical certificate from the competent medical authority for his fitness to und ertake / continue the work and the same should be submitted to PCs. Co oks should be free from any communicable diseases. 22. Cooks should necessarily wear uniforms of the prescribed pattern with a headgear which is compulsory during cooking of food. 23. The Rly. Administration reserves the right to terminate the con tract of the work without assigning any reason and issuing any n otice.

24. In case of any contradictions between central condition of contract and special conditions of contract, the later shall prevail. 25. In case the contractor fails to provide the services as enumerated in the L etter of Acceptance, E.Co.Railway reserves the right to terminate the cont ract. 26. The cook should clean the utensils as well as supply of meals to the duty p osts at different locations of duty beats. 27. The agency before deploying any person for working, should also issue ide ntity card with photo duly signed by the Contractor(S). 28. The agency shall be solely responsible for maintenance of discipline of th e personnel so deployed by it from time to time. 29. The agency shall be responsible for the payment of salaries/wages and othe r allowances payable for their own personnel and in doing so shall comply with the required statutory rules/regulations, payment of minimum wages etc. as prescribed by the Central Government from time to time. 30. The agency shall be solely liable for an accident/injury caused to their pers onnel or to their parties arising out of and in the course of employment an d that the agency shall comply with the procedures such as reporting to a ppropriate authorities, treatment of the injured and meeting the expenses incidental thereto, payment of compensation etc. 31. The successful agency should execute the contract work awarded and sub-contracting of work is not permitted. 32. The agency shall not deploy/engage any worker, who has not complete d the age of 18 years on the date of his/her deployment/engagement. 33. Before commencement of contract, the agency/firm/tenderer has to submit p olice verification certificate in support of his character and he should not be involved in any criminal cases. 34. The agency shall pay to each of his workmen the wages at the rate prescr ibed as per the minimum wages act (CLC). 35. Ensure that the cooks indulging in undesirable acts shall be changed by t he contractor forthwith on receipt of advice from the railways. The decision of the railways as to what is an ‘undesirable act’ will not be open to question. 36. The agency shall provide substitute cook immediately in case of absence of any cook. 37. Person suffering from any contagious or infectious disease shall not be emp loyed or permitted to work in the railway premises. 38. Attendance of the cook/helper will be maintained daily by PCs. 39. The housing accommodation for contractor’s labour will have to be arrang ed by contractor strictly as per prevailing labour contract Act. 40. No compensation what-so-ever towards any accident or injury sustained to labourers will be paid by Railway. 41. MODE OF PAYMENT (i) Monthly payment will be made on actual execution of work, on production of relevant documents along with the bills complete in all respects & duly ce rtified by the Consignee. (ii) The rate/amount of taxes as indicated in Schedule-A is only appro ximate & based on the prevailing labour charges. GST as applicable fr om time to time during the currency of the contract should be paid by tende rer(s) & the amount so paid towards the same will be reimbursed on product ion of documentary evidence.

iii) The taxes i.e. GST will be reimbursed to the tenderer(s) on actual basis onl y on production of original receipts issued by concerned Central Govt./State Govt. authority. The original receipt should bear the Contract Agreement No. & Date as well as amount so paid in words and figures. If the tenderer(s) fails to produce original receipts along with the bill the amount towards the above statutory taxes will be recovered from every bill by Railway and kept i n deposits and to be released in favour of tenderer(s) on production of docu mentary proof by them subject to verification of genuineness of the said doc uments by Railway. iv) The monthly bill should be verified and forwarded to DSC/RPF/SBP for passing of bills. ECR copy of the above should be deposited in the subsequent month by the contractor along with the bill. (v) The payment to contract labour has to be made directly through bank and n ot by cash by the tenderer(s) before 1st week of every month. This will be irr espective of his/their getting payment from principal employer or not. (vi) Before next month’s bill is cleared for payment, the tenderer(s) will submit photocopy of the bank statement showing that payments have been made di rectly to bank accounts along with the amount of money paid to each accoun t. This proof of payment must be submitted along with the bill for the next m onth. For example, proof of payment for the month of January must be submitted along with the bill for the month of February. 42. Penalty (i) Penalty for paying absent Rs.1500/- per day will be recovered from the mo nthly bill of the contractor by DSC/SBP. If not wearing uniform during cookin g of meals a fine of Rs.1000.00 will be imposed. Appeal against fine if any will be decided by DSC/SBP. (ii) The contractor before commencement of work should submit a declaration from each worker that he has not been arrested/imprisoned in any case and no police case is pending against him & full Bio-data. . 6. Service & Support The Service Provider is required to have at least 10 % of the required manpower on service provider’s payroll for at least one year. Necessary documents relating to such manpower will be uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. Such manpower will be part of total manpower to be provided by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid. 7.
